# Shoibur Rahman

> The personal digital diary of Shoibur Rahman — student, web developer, and curious mind based in Bangladesh.

## Pages

- [Home](/): Welcome, quick bio, and highlights.
- [Journey](/journey): Education timeline, current studies, and future plans.
- [People](/people): Family, teachers, and close friends.
- [Memories](/memories): Hobbies, travel stories, and personal moments.
- [Certificates](/#certificates): Certificates and achievements.
- [Research & Posts](/#posts): Articles, notes, and research (individual posts live at /post/{slug}).
- [Thoughts](/thoughts): Personal quotes, advice, and reflections.
- [Contact](/contact): Get in touch.
